verdict.rationale: Browsing files, commit history and blame is a core axis for a code-hosting platform, so it applies. However, no evidence item documents web-based file browsing, commit history views, or line-by-line blame. The closest items cover downloading or cloning repositories and Copilot's ability to 'explore your repositories', which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse repository files, commit history, and line-by-line blame in the web interface
